objective: Register one finite editable-first-draft iteration across Understanding, exact-visible confirmation and protected report delivery; remove application business-quality vetoes while preserving technical/security boundaries. Registration changes governance only.
requirements: Accepted Confluence 03.07 v28 and 03.08 v9, Jira APBRA-160 decision 10575 and direct owner handback recorded in PLAN 10576 govern one bounded editable-first-draft iteration. The handback supersedes the documentation hold. PR103 is diagnostic-only and preserves old business vetoes; its proposed scope is superseded for this iteration, without erasing its evidence.

The qualified LLM alone owns business interpretation and report design using the full saved request, evidence, history and actually available conventions. Remove business-correctness, completeness, obligation-coverage, semantic-equivalence and design-quality vetoes across Understanding/readiness, confirmation materialization and generation. Business imperfections must not prevent technically processable editable-draft delivery. Do not rename a business gate as a technical guard.

Keep explicit user acceptance bound to the exact visible interpretation and current context/version. Freshness and provenance are mandatory; they do not prove business equivalence or completeness. Questions are optional, including zero; preserve configured question-count and explicit expert-routing controls without imposing an uncertainty-based business-quality gate.

Retain server-derived actor/tenant authorization, private-resource isolation, permissions, protected credentials, configured budgets and provider call/timeout/output limits, typed structural/protocol validity, unique valid IDs and references, supported artifact/compiler operations, constructibility, package/file integrity and protected download. Unknown fields or unsupported operations must fail safely when they prevent execution; missing business coverage alone must not.

No canned fallback, fabricated model success, hardcoded retail reasoning, request simplification or automatic acceptance on the user behalf. Preserve the saved real retail request, full requirements, CSV, immutable history and existing protected artifacts. Synthetic offline tests never certify the meaning of that real request.

Initial milestone uses existing model/provider and compiler. Existing bundled generation documents and available conventions must be labelled truthfully. Provider-managed administrator upload to configured provider retrieval, currently Foundry, remains desired separate unimplemented scope; no RAG provisioning, uploads, dependencies or false tenant-grounding claim.

Paid calls remain prohibited. The earlier single-test approval is consumed; the below-A$5 ceiling is not fresh call authority. Do not alter preview, tenant settings, credentials, deployment configuration or permissions. Stop before any paid provider request.

Preserve existing safe bounded failure accounting and rollback boundaries. Supplied token usage remains observed usage or null when unknown; never persist raw prompts, provider/bridge candidates, error envelopes, secrets or private report content. No stale or malformed result becomes a success.
adrs: The qualified LLM owns interpretation and business design; the user confirms exact visible meaning. Deterministic code retains narrow execution, authorization, lifecycle, budget and file-integrity policy. Software does not certify business quality of an editable first draft.

Remove superseded business vetoes throughout the chain rather than bypassing only one adapter. Keep provider strict wire schemas and runtime typed validity; semantic completeness/equivalence is not a release condition for an otherwise executable first draft.

Registration, implementation, genuinely separate independent exact-head review, hosted CI, Haseeb manual merge and verified main are separate gates. Technical execution PASS and editable-draft status must remain distinct from business acceptance, Power BI Desktop qualification and successful deployment.
